summary: This is a markdown document with two sections, each marked with a heading (## syntax) and an anchor ID in curly braces. Each section heading is preceded by an HTML comment telling a renderer to highlight that specific line. The content between headings is Lorem Ipsum placeholder text.

explanations.1: The HTML comment `<!-- highlight-next-line -->` is an instruction to a markdown processor (likely Docusaurus or similar) to visually emphasize or highlight the very next line of content.
explanations.2: The `{#intro}` syntax creates an anchor link with ID 'intro' — this lets other pages link directly to this section using a URL like `page#intro`.
